questions.stem: HYDROGEN is the most abundant element in the:

options.option_text: Earth's crust by mass percentage
Universe by mass and atom count
Earth's atmosphere by volume share
Human body by mass and weight

questions.explanation: Hydrogen — most abundant element in the UNIVERSE (~75% of normal matter by mass; ~92% by atom count). Stars are mostly hydrogen + helium fusion. Earth's atmosphere — N₂ (78%), O₂ (21%); H₂ very rare. Earth's crust — O (46%), Si (28%) dominate. Human body by mass — O > C > H > N. By atom count, H is most abundant in human body. Distractor 1 — Earth's crust is dominated by O. Distractor 3 — atmosphere is mostly N₂ + O₂.

questions.stem: Hydrogen has THREE isotopes. The one with one proton + 2 neutrons (heaviest) is called:

options.option_text: Protium, the lightest H isotope of all
Tritium, the radioactive H isotope
Deuterium, the heavy H isotope
Helium, a different element entirely

questions.explanation: H isotopes: PROTIUM (¹H, 1 proton, 0 neutrons; 99.98% of natural H); DEUTERIUM (²H or D, 1p+1n; ~0.02%); TRITIUM (³H or T, 1p+2n; trace, RADIOACTIVE, half-life 12.3 yr). Deuterium oxide (D₂O) = 'heavy water', moderator in PHWR nuclear reactors. Tritium — used in self-luminous gun sights, exit signs, fusion research. Distractor 4 — Helium is element 2, separate.

questions.stem: When hydrogen burns in oxygen, the product formed is:

options.option_text: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) commercially used
Water (H₂O) plus a lot of energy released
Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is the only product
Ozone (O₃) is the predominant product formed

questions.explanation: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O + heat. Highly EXOTHERMIC (~286 kJ/mol H₂). Hydrogen + oxygen mixture explodes on ignition (Hindenburg disaster, 1937). Used in rocket fuel (LH₂/LOX, e.g., Saturn V upper stages, Space Shuttle main engines). Hydrogen FUEL CELL — generates electricity from H₂ + O₂ → water + electricity (clean: only water as exhaust). Distractor 1 — H₂O₂ formed only under specific conditions. Distractor 3 — no carbon involved. Distractor 4 — ozone forms from O₂ via UV/electrical discharge, not from H₂ combustion.

questions.stem: HYDROGENATION of vegetable oils to produce VANASPATI (vegetable ghee) involves:

options.option_text: Removing all unsaturated bonds with high heat
Adding hydrogen across C=C double bonds with Ni catalyst
Adding water to break ester bonds in oils
Mixing oils with sodium hydroxide solution

questions.explanation: HYDROGENATION — addition of H₂ across C=C double bonds. Liquid vegetable oils (unsaturated) + H₂ + NICKEL CATALYST → solid/semi-solid fats (saturated). Process developed by Wilhelm Normann (1901). Used to make: vanaspati ghee, margarine. Cons: TRANS FATS form as side product (linked to heart disease) — banned/limited in many countries (FSSAI India: <2% trans fat by 2022). Distractor 3 = hydrolysis. Distractor 4 = saponification (soap-making).

questions.stem: Hydrogen is sometimes called the 'fuel of the future'. The KEY ADVANTAGE over fossil fuels is:

options.option_text: Easily stored at room temperature in tanks
Produces only water on combustion (no CO₂)
Has higher density than petrol fuel always
Is the cheapest fuel available currently

questions.explanation: Hydrogen burns to produce ONLY WATER → no CO₂, no SO₂, no NOx (if combustion is controlled). Truly clean fuel — IF the H₂ is made cleanly. Currently most H₂ is made from natural gas (steam reforming, 'grey hydrogen' — releases CO₂). 'GREEN HYDROGEN' = made via electrolysis powered by renewables; the holy grail. India's National Hydrogen Mission (2021) targets 5 MTPA green H₂ by 2030. Distractor 1 — H₂ is HARD to store (needs high pressure or low T). Distractor 3 — H₂ has very LOW volumetric energy density. Distractor 4 — H₂ is currently expensive.

questions.stem: Hydrogen does NOT have a fixed position in the periodic table because:

options.option_text: It is too rare on Earth to be classified well
It shares some properties with both Group 1 and Group 17
It is the most reactive element on Earth
It does not form chemical compounds in nature

questions.explanation: Hydrogen ANOMALY: 1 valence electron — like ALKALI METALS (Group 1) — can lose to form H⁺. BUT also needs 1 more to fill its shell — like HALOGENS (Group 17) — can gain to form H⁻ (hydride). Different periodic tables place H in Group 1, Group 17, or floating alone. NOT a metal at room temp + pressure (gas, non-metallic), unlike alkali metals. Forms diatomic molecule (H₂) like halogens. Sometimes called 'rogue' element.

questions.stem: When dilute hydrochloric acid reacts with zinc metal, the gas evolved is:

options.option_text: Oxygen, supporting combustion strongly
Hydrogen, with characteristic 'pop' sound test
Chlorine, a yellow-green choking gas
Carbon dioxide, turning lime water milky

questions.explanation: Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂↑. Hydrogen gas. Test: bring a lit splint near the gas → makes a CHARACTERISTIC 'POP' SOUND (mini-explosion as H₂ + O₂ in air ignites). Reactivity series — metals more reactive than H (Zn, Mg, Al, Fe) displace H from acids. Cu, Ag, Au don't react with dilute HCl. Distractor 1 = decomposition of H₂O₂ produces O₂. Distractor 3 = reaction with strong oxidisers. Distractor 4 = carbonate + acid reactions.
